brief: A premium 15-second perfume campaign: a droplet on wet black stone, a rim-lit silhouette, cap and glass details cut on the beat, the word NEW DROP once, a final hero frame.
First person: I look at the camera as the moment changes me. Two scenes in the same place, close-ups of the face and hands, a quiet twist in the last shot.
Fast hype edit: a night city, drifting cars and a lone figure in motion, close-ups cut on the beat, a burst of flashes at the drop.
A slowed dreamy edit of a quiet street at dusk and a figure walking, long drifting holds, a faded VHS look, a few soft words like lyrics.
The same person changes outfit on the beat, four looks, the same pose before and after each change, full-body shots.
A glow-up: plain and tired in a small kitchen, one turning point, then confident and polished in the same kitchen, a hero ending.
A skincare serum bottle: texture of the liquid, the glass, the dropper, a calm reveal, soft light.
A short event: a courier runs through the rain, drops a parcel at a door, the door opens, a hand takes it.
A music video for a late-night electronic track: a performer in a neon corridor, push-ins on the hits, colour that pulses.
Aura farming: a stoic skater in golden-hour fog, one signature gesture that comes back with variations, a long confident hold at the end.
